chronology: The mathematical core and42 table prefixes were frozen before production Rust. The small importable wrapper and safe-API serialization/type/domain policy were prepared later, after the peer had read the production source. Only the unchanged pre-Rust functional core is independent pre-source authority; later wrapper construction is not relabeled as pre-Rust or source-blind work.
corpus: Only39 caller-qualified cases are the implementation corpus. Three standalone cases remain distinct; private novel values are not copied into this export.
native_binding: The wrapper does not read a target, provider, Rust, or expected file. The build runner must separately freshly authenticate the native provider and its actual facts before a target-bound comparison.
source_behavior: The wrapper itself performs no target/provider/Rust/expected-file reads. That source-level property is distinct from the wrapper author having reviewed production source before preparing this later wrapper.
